heading.purpose: UI headings and navigation. System stack for native feel.

body.purpose: All body text and UI labels. PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei for CJK.

serif.purpose: Reading mode only. Creates paper-book immersion.

mono.purpose: Code display and monospace data (job IDs, URLs).

compact-label.purpose: 0.625-0.8rem admin density step (nav 0.7rem, kicker 0.65rem, table head 0.68rem, meta pill 0.75rem, pagination 0.8rem, sidebar group 0.625rem). OPERATE-mode scan efficiency over reading comfort; contrast must still meet AA 4.5:1.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Subtle card/button resting shadow — like paper lifting slightly.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Modal dialog overlay — heaviest shadow, still warm-toned.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Milk-tea brown background, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8B6045; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; min-height: 2.25rem; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #74503A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B6045; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(139,96,69,0.24); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default action button. Warm linen background, dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #F6F4F1; color: #211E1A; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #ECE8E2; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; min-height: 2.25rem; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F5F2EE; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Icon-only row action. Transparent, appears on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #5B554E; padding: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 2rem; min-height: 2rem; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #211E1A; background: rgba(139,96,69,0.05); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content surface. Clean paper background, warm border, no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg-card, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--admin-border, #ECE8E2); border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: none; } .ds-card-header { margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-card-header h3 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #211E1A; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input. Clean border, warm focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #211E1A; border: 1px solid #ECE8E2; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; min-height: 2.25rem; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #8B6045; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(139,96,69,0.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9A938A; }

components.name: Table
components.description: Data table with sticky header and warm border container.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { border: 1px solid var(--admin-border, #ECE8E2); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-card, #FFFFFF); overflow: hidden; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; min-width: 46rem; } .ds-table th { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 2.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #ECE8E2; background: #F0EDE9; color: #9A938A; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-table td { height: 3.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #ECE8E2; color: #5B554E; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: rgba(139,96,69,0.05); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status indicator pill. Semantic color variants.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; background: #F6F4F1; color: #5B554E; border: 1px solid #ECE8E2; } .ds-badge-success { background: rgba(79,122,82,0.1); color: #4F7A52; } .ds-badge-warning { background: rgba(176,124,47,0.1); color: #B07C2F; } .ds-badge-danger { background: rgba(190,18,60,0.1); color: #BE123C; }

narrative.overview:
知舟的设计语言来自一个简单的感觉：在温暖的光线下翻阅纸质书。界面是安静的，像书房里被台灯照亮的纸页——没有刺眼的对比，没有冰冷的玻璃感，只有柔和的奶油色地面和深沉的墨色文字。这不是一个"科技产品"的界面，而是一个"阅读空间"的界面。

色彩来自奶茶和旧书页：暖棕作为唯一的强调色（像书脊上的烫金字），大面积使用接近白色的暖灰和奶油色作为呼吸空间。阴影克制而自然，像纸页层叠投下的微光。组件有微妙的触觉感——圆润但不幼稚，边框细致如精装书的切边。
keyCharacteristics: 奶茶色暖调贯穿，拒绝冷色和高饱和度
纸质感地面（接近白色的暖灰），文字如墨迹
阴影极简，依赖色调层次而非投影创造深度
系统字体 + 衬线字体用于阅读场景
组件触感温暖，圆角适度，像精心制作的文具

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: 奶茶棕色强调色在任何页面上不超过 10% 的面积。它的稀有性就是力量——读者的眼睛自然被引导到最重要的交互点。

rules.name: The Content-First Rule
rules.body: 字体永远是配角。系统字体不创造风格，内容本身创造风格。唯一例外是阅读器中的衬线体——那是为沉浸而存在的。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 所有表面在静止状态是平的。阴影仅作为状态响应出现（hover、elevation、focus），或为弹出层提供层次暗示。

dos: Do 使用暖灰色调作为地面和背景，保持"纸面"质感
Do 保持强调色的稀缺性——奶茶棕只出现在交互元素和品牌标记上
Do 在管理后台使用 --admin-* 语义化间距和圆角变量
Do 在阅读器场景使用衬线字体营造沉浸感
Do 保持卡片和面板的扁平设计，仅在弹出层使用阴影
Do 在暗色模式使用月光暖调（金色强调 + 深灰地面），不要简单反转
donts: Don't 使用纯黑（#000000）或纯白作为大面积背景——永远带暖调
Don't 使用冷色蓝/紫/绿作为强调色——系统只有暖棕一个强调色
Don't 给卡片添加 hover 阴影效果——Flat-By-Default Rule
Don't 使用超过 3 种字号层级——保持排版的克制和统一
Don't 在管理后台使用花哨的动画——仅使用 160ms ease-out 的微妙过渡
Don't 忽略 prefers-reduced-motion 媒体查询——尊重用户的动画偏好
